method: Load the exact frozen algorithm module and replace its _preprocess function only for downsample1. GaussianBlur is applied to float green pixels before the existing sigma5 high-pass. Downsample4 remains unchanged. Replay all four exact NPZ pixel/pose/landmark inputs. Baseline results are copied from the frozen extended report, not recomputed.
limitations: Isolated development candidate chosen after observing stationary failure; no held-out claim. No production edits, neural inference or defect accuracy. Prefilter settings are an engineering adaptation; the research paper does not prescribe this native-resolution extension.
first_sigma_rationale: sqrt((4^2-1)/12): variance of a four-pixel discrete box averaging kernel.
